# Chicago Bulls Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-09-28, 35:33. https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw

## Summary

Josh Lloyd previews the Chicago Bulls for the 2026-27 fantasy season. He expects the Bulls to be a bad team. His projected starting five is Josh Giddey, Norman Powell, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson and Nick Claxton, with Tre Jones as sixth man. Buzelis is his best target. He thinks Buzelis is a top 50 player whose Yahoo rank of about 80 is far too low. Claxton is his biggest fade at his Yahoo price of about 80. Tre Jones looks overdrafted, Jalen Smith is a late swing pick for deep leagues, and Leonard Miller is a stash. The Bulls' fantasy playoff schedule is average.

## Rules and methods

- [6:41](https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw?t=401) Points, rebounds and assists count the same as other categories, but they vary less from game to game and season to season. That makes them more reliable to build a team around.
  > "percentages, but you should treat them slightly differently because of the game-to-ame and season to season variance"
- [7:36](https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw?t=456) A reliable points, rebounds and assists player is better than a player whose value comes from steals, blocks and percentages, because the production repeats more reliably.
  > "Like versus being a steals, blocks, and free throw guy or a steals, blocks, and field goal guy"
- [9:26](https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw?t=566) No player is a must grab. Do not reach. Value comes from the gap between where you draft a player and where he finishes. Getting about 40 spots of value is almost a league winner.
  > "Nobody is the must grab player, right? So, if you think, well, I've got to get Balis."
- [18:33](https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw?t=1113) Rankings differ a lot between Yahoo, ESPN and Fantrax, so whether a player is a bust or a steal depends on your platform and format.
  > "This is where the difference in platforms is important. He's been aggressively ranked up on Yahoo."
- [23:34](https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw?t=1414) A 12 team league has about 120 starting level players. A 16 team league drafts about 200 players.
  > "A 12 team league is 120 players who were starters."
- [25:07](https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw?t=1507) Do not value a player based on whether he won or ruined your league last season. Last season will not repeat.
  > "reassess everything that you're doing because that's not how any of this works. We're not repeating last season."
- [25:42](https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw?t=1542) Your last pick or last few picks should be upside flyers.
  > "your last pick and last couple of picks should probably just be an upside flyer"
- [29:04](https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw?t=1744) Two threes per game is league average in fantasy, so a shooter who only hits two threes is nothing special.
  > "he's hitting two threes a game, remember two threes is league average for fantasy"
- [34:14](https://youtu.be/3Qm5wLjhvTw?t=2054) Leaving out teams with two game playoff weeks, fantasy schedules are mostly comparable and should not change player valuations much. The recommended season end date is March 28. The Yahoo default end date is April 4.
  > "most team schedules outside of teams that have two game playoff weeks, they're all relatively comparable"
